intro: Squadro is clarity made visible — a bed where strong structure, thoughtful storage, and calm finishes come together to give your bedroom both order and ease.

features.title: Geometry that holds you steady
features.text: The grid-panelled headboard adds quiet rhythm and symmetry to your space — a sense of balance that brings both visual and emotional stillness to the room.

features.title: A frame that doesn’t falter
features.text: Crafted from engineered wood, the frame is built for daily use and long-term support — a strong, silent foundation that keeps its shape through time.

features.title: Storage that lifts without effort
features.text: A smooth lift-up reveals deep box storage beneath the bed — easy to access, effortless to use, and perfect for keeping your space clear and your life uncluttered. Plus, all Upmods beds come with versatile storage options to suit your unique lifestyle.

features.title: A finish that speaks softly
features.text: The matte wood surface brings warmth and calm into your space — absorbing light just enough to create a grounded, restful atmosphere.

features.title: Toughness that stays quiet
features.text: Protected with an anti-scratch PU coating, the surface resists wear, dust, and everyday friction — keeping your bed looking its best, no matter the mess.

name: Upmods Squadro Queen Size Engineered Wood Bed With Box Storage
